scope: Post-result paired comparison of saved patient-held-out predictions; no refitting or primary-formula change
uncertainty: 2000 paired-patient bootstrap samples, same draws across methods; score each validation repetition before averaging. Exploratory pointwise intervals, no confirmatory multiplicity claim.
limits: Local serum model was developed on this population; p-EASI is transferred across unbridged assays. Low IL22 availability restricts matched sample. W24 previously inspected within-cohort. This comparison cannot establish independent superiority or a wholly molecular explanation of hybrid performance.
